subject: prd/implement-now
statement: For every implementation routing attempt, the executor shall record exactly one plan/v2 frozen-demand or typed plan/v1 translation origin, the selected harness and implementation role, requested profile, effective policy version, and exactly one resolution terminal: an exact/promoted EVT-7 with native profile identity and exactly one connected EVT-10 verified, failed, or blocked worker outcome with available usage, or an unsupported/policy-invalid EVT-8 with no worker outcome; the bounded records shall be immutable and contain no prompt or code payload.
rationale: native choices need auditability without fabricating a worker outcome for a pre-claim failure or pretending legacy provenance
fit_criterion: every conformance and dogfood attempt joins exactly one origin to exactly one EVT-7 or EVT-8; every EVT-7 joins exactly one EVT-10 and every EVT-8 joins zero EVT-10; missing, duplicate, and cross-class terminals fail; retries append rather than overwrite; payload inspection is clean
